rows.grounds: reduplicated imperative of √kṛ expressing urgent command
compound object denoting a maiden associated with gods and demons
bīja syllable, transliterated without semantic translation
epithet addressing the goddess as dear to wealth or the Vasus

items.question: What action is the wealth-beloved goddess commanded to perform upon the god-demon maiden?
premises: The speaker utters a reduplicated imperative command to act.
The specified object is the maiden of gods and demons.
The bīja hrīṃ and the epithet wealth-beloved invoke the addressed goddess.
items.inference: The invoked wealth-beloved goddess is commanded to act upon the god-demon maiden.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or magical effect intended by the command is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Do, do make the maiden of gods and demons yours, hrīṃ, O beloved of wealth.
